name: What is the biggest mistake homeowners make during interior remodeling?

mainEntity.name: What is the biggest mistake homeowners make during an interior remodel that causes budget overruns and delays?
mainEntity.text: What is the biggest mistake homeowners make during an interior remodel that causes budget overruns and delays?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common mistake is beginning too early without a fully defined scope, budget, and selection list. When decisions are still open during construction, the project often accumulates change orders, schedule gaps, and frustration. Homeowners also underestimate how much hidden work older homes can require, which makes a contingency essential. Another frequent issue is choosing contractors based only on the lowest bid instead of the clearest proposal. The best way to avoid problems is to finish design decisions before demolition, confirm what is included in writing, and leave room in the budget for the unexpected. Clear planning saves more money than last-minute changes ever do.
acceptedAnswer.description: The biggest mistake is starting construction before the scope, budget, and selections are fully defined. Change orders, unclear allowances, and late design decisions are major causes of overruns. Hidden conditions are manageable, but constant changes to layout or finishes usually create the most avoidable delays and extra costs.
